description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'read-tree -m -u' command in Git, including setup for multiple test scenarios, including different tree configurations, conflict scenarios, file modifications, and special cases like symlinks and directory/file conflicts.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up and run a test case expecting success, with a description string and the test commands.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_succeed
methods.description: Runs 'read_tree -m -u' with given arguments and expects it to succeed; captures output for validation.

methods.name: read_tree_u_must_fail
methods.description: Runs 'read_tree -m -u' with given arguments and expects it to fail; captures output for validation.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests finish.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a given command must fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files.
